statement: Envelope descent into a certified floor. For a realized word w at n (follows n w), if n ^ 3^{#O(w)} ≤ N₀ ^ 2^{|w|} as integers then floorPower^[|w|] n ≤ N₀ (iterate_le_of_envelope, from power_bound_word and Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left); if moreover every 1 ≤ m ≤ N₀ lies in a backward-closed class A, then n ∈ A (mem_of_envelope_floor); in particular, with A = ReachesOne and the realized itinerary of the first k steps, n ^ 3^{#O(itinerary n k)} ≤ N₀ ^ 2^k implies ReachesOne n (reachesOne_of_itinerary_envelope). This is the exact step of the Tao-type reduction: a start whose exponent walk reaches −L(y) = −log₂(log 2y / log N₀) within d steps enters [1, N₀]. Not a halt theorem.

Theorem B′ of the Tao-reduction note (biased-split form). Let 0 < q < log 2 / log 3 = 0.6309…, μ = 1 − q log₂ 3 > 0, C > 1/μ, e_q(C) = 2 (Cμ − 1)² / (C (log₂ 3)² ln 2) = 1.1486·(Cμ − 1)²/C. Hypothesis H_q(C, A): for all large y, every 1 ≤ t < d(y) = ⌈C L(y)⌉ and every O-rooted L(y)-bad word w of length t, the cylinder [w]_y of odd starts in (y, 2y] sends at most q·#[w]_y + y (log y)^{−A} of its members to an odd next state (one-sided odd-share bound with additive slack), A > C + e_q(C). With only A > C, the proof supplies any rate below min(e_q(C), A-C), not necessarily e_q(C). Then for every ε > 0 and large y, #{n odd in (y, 2y] : n does not reach 1} ≤ (y/2) (log 2y / log N₀)^{−(e_q(C) − ε)}. Proof: append synthetic E letters after the first envelope crossing; on bad prefixes the synthetic word equals the actual word, and on crossed atoms the odd excess is zero. The synthetic exponent walk u_t = o_t log₂ 3 − t has conditional drift ≤ −μ + η_t log₂ 3 with E[Σ η_t] ≤ 4 (log 2y/log N₀)^C (log y)^{−A}; a start not reaching 1 has u_d > −L (envelope descent, J-fate-envelope-floor); Markov on the slack and Azuma–Hoeffding on the martingale part (increment range log₂ 3) give the bound. With Theorem A (J-tao-rate-implies-conjecture): e_q(C) > 1 − λ** = 0.5074 implies the Juggler conjecture; least C: 19 at q = 1/2, 41 at q = 0.55, 223 at q = 0.60, 1586 at q = 0.62. Hence: if no L(y)-bad cylinder of depth below 41 log₂(log 2y / log N₀) sends more than 55% of its members to an odd state, every positive integer reaches 1. Anatomy (exact DP): among fair-coin bad words at (y, d) = (10^100, 75) the fraction containing an odd run ≥ 4 is 0.9999 and ≥ 5 is 0.988, so the hypothesis cannot be met by controlling bounded odd runs — it is the O⁴ → O⁵ split (Conjecture 7.3, K₃) and its iterates. Odd-run census on (10^6, 2·10^6]: the cylinders O^t split with odd-share within binomial noise of 1/2 for t ≤ 14. Not a halt theorem; the hypothesis is not proved. The old all-prefix version is REFUTED by J-unstopped-cylinder-bound; the restricted hypothesis remains unproved.

Tao-reduction note §10.4(d), corrected scope 9 September 2026. With D(w)=#[wO]-#[w]/2 and the global collision count C_t=sum_{|w|=t} #[w]^2, Parseval gives sum_w D(w)^2=2^{-t-2} sum_{S subset [0,t)} |W_{S union {t}}|^2=C_{t+1}/2-C_t/4. Thus global Walsh and collision bounds are representations of the same second-moment information, not a new mechanism. A sufficiently strong global pair-correlation estimate implies the almost-all bad-prefix split bound and the corrected bad-cylinder H(C,A); equivalence to that restricted H is no longer asserted. The former unrestricted all-word H is refuted by J-absorbed-cylinder. The live pressure P_theta is unchanged and unproved. Do not re-derive nearby Walsh/correlation formulations as new hypotheses.

Theorem B and Corollary C of the Tao-reduction note. Let L(y) = log₂(log 2y / log N₀), d(y) = ⌈C L(y)⌉, p_C = (1 − 1/C)/log₂ 3, e(C) = C D(p_C ‖ 1/2)/ln 2 (Chernoff exponent; e(21) = 0.621, e(25) = 0.812, e(30) = 1.054). The L-bad words of length d ≥ C L (exponent walk never reaching −L) number at most 2^d 2^{−e(C) L}, and the O-rooted ones at most 2^{d−1} 2^{−(e(C)−ε) L} for L large. Under the cylinder bound H(C, A) — every O-rooted L(y)-bad word w of length d(y) has #{n odd in (y, 2y] : word_{d(y)}(n) = w} ≤ 2^{−(d(y)−1)} y/2 + y (log y)^{−A} (the fair share of an O-rooted cylinder among the y/2 odd starts, whose first letter is O), with A > C + e(C) — all but (y/2)(log 2y / log N₀)^{−(e(C)−ε)} odd starts in (y, 2y] enter [1, N₀] within d(y) = O(log log y) steps (envelope descent, J-fate-envelope-floor). Hence H(C, A) with C ≥ 19 (rate threshold 1 − λ** = 0.5074; C ≥ 19 against the V_5 truncation 0.4924, the V_4 truncation 0.4916, the V_3 truncation 0.4891 and the OEOEE truncation 0.4801; C ≥ 20 against the pairing-only root 0.4480; C ≥ 18 against 1 − λ*** = 0.4608) implies the Juggler conjecture through J-tao-rate-implies-conjecture. The depth is O(log log y) because the Juggler descent is by powers (one certificate sends n to n^e); the Collatz analogue would need depth Θ(log y), where cylinders have single elements. Exact walk counts (data/research/juggler/tao_reduction/summary.json) show depth ≈ 17 L(y) would suffice in place of 20 L(y). Census with the certified floor N₀ = 3.5·10^8 as target (tao_census, OBSERVATION): for random odd starts in (y, 2y], y = 10^12 … 10^50, the fraction of exact orbits still above N₀ after d ≤ 40 steps matches the odd-start fair-coin survival P[u_t > −L(y) ∀ t ≤ d | u_1 = log₂ 3 − 1] within 3% for d ≥ 10 (ratios 0.92–1.05): the aggregate odd share along surviving prefixes is 1/2. H(C, A) is the conjecture juggler_loglog_depth_cylinder_bound; depth ≤ 4 is Paper B, depth 5 is the K₃ wall. Not a halt theorem. Scope correction 9 September 2026: the former all-word version is REFUTED by J-absorbed-cylinder; this row uses only the bad-word restriction already present in the Lean union bound.

Theorem B‴ and Proposition 10.1 of the Tao-reduction note (the weakest per-scale form in the displayed hierarchy; see J-pressure-scale-average-suffices for the corrected scale-averaged variant). Let τ(n) be the entrance time of the orbit of n into the certified floor [1, N₀], o_t(n) the number of odd letters among n, …, J^{t−1}(n), d(y) = ⌈C L(y)⌉, a_θ = (1 + e^θ)/2. Live pressure P_θ(C): (1/N) Σ_{n odd in (y,2y], τ(n) > d} e^{θ o_d(n)} ≤ a_θ^d e^{o(d)}. Theorem B‴: P_θ(C) at θ_C = log(p_C/(1 − p_C)) gives #{n odd in (y,2y] : τ(n) > d(y)} ≤ (y/2)(log 2y / log N₀)^{−(e(C) − ε)}, the bound of Theorem B (proof: τ > d ⟹ u_d > −L ⟹ o_d ≥ p_C d, then the exponential Markov inequality; θ p_C − log a_θ = D(p_C ‖ 1/2)); hence P_{θ_C}(C) with C ≥ 19 implies the Juggler conjecture. No-momentum form M_{θ,q}(C): with μ_{θ,t} the measure on live starts with density ∝ e^{θ o_t(n)} and s_θ(t) = μ_{θ,t}(J^t(n) odd) the tilted odd share, Σ_{t<d} (s_θ(t) − q)^+ = o(d) implies P_θ (q = 1/2) and, for 0 < q < p_C < 1, gives #{τ > d} ≤ N exp(−d D(p_C ‖ q)(1 − o(1))) only when M is assumed at the optimizing tilt θ = log(p_C(1-q)/(q(1-p_C))). At an arbitrary positive tilt the exponent is θ p_C − log(1-q+q e^θ), with an o(1) error — at the optimizing tilt the logarithmic rate is C D(p_C ‖ q)/ln 2, at least Azuma’s (least C: 19 at q = 1/2, 41 at 0.55, 214 at 0.60, 1496 at 0.62). The stopping at the floor is essential (J(1) = 1 is odd; the unstopped odd count of every start that reaches 1 grows linearly). Consequences (§10.4): any o(log log y) initial depths are free (each letter costs a factor ≤ e^θ), so K₃ and every fixed-depth split are irrelevant to the reduction; the tower O^t enters only through its tilted weight (β e^θ/a_θ)^{t−1} and is harmless below odd share (1 + e^{−θ})/2 = 0.836 at θ = 0.396 (H_q needs < 0.6309; the conclusion fails only above 2^{−e(C)/C} = 0.981); Walsh sums of order |T| enter the unstopped moment with weight tanh(θ/2)^{|T|}; and no bounded-depth cylinder statement can close the reduction (a word measure fair to depth k and all-O afterwards satisfies every depth-≤ k statement and violates the bound). The wall is the tilted average split of typical odd-heavy live words at depth ≍ log log y, not any individual cylinder. Census (pressure_census, OBSERVATION): s_θ(t) ∈ [0.44, 0.56] for t ≤ 40 at y = 10^12, 10^20, 10^30, 10^50 (40000 exact orbits each), cumulative excess over 1/2 equal to the positive-part noise, live moments within 5–8% of the fair DP. Not a halt theorem; the hypothesis is not proved. EVIDENCE AUDIT (this session). The census line above -- 'cumulative excess over 1/2 equal to the positive-part noise' -- is true and carries NO information, because the statistic sum_t (s_theta(t) - 1/2)^+ is biased upward by its own sampling error. A positive part turns symmetric error into a positive contribution, so under the exact null s_theta == 1/2 the statistic already sits at sum_t sd_t/sqrt(2 pi) with sd_t = 1/(2 sqrt(ESS_t)); and that floor GROWS with depth, because ESS falls as liveness thins the sample and the tilt concentrates the weights (ESS 40000 at depth 1 against 553 at depth 40, from 40000 samples). Tested against the exact null -- same live set, same weights, next letter replaced by a fair coin -- the measured 0.1873 at y = 1e12 sits against 0.1714 +/- 0.0459, p = 0.365, with the analytic floor 0.1722 matching the simulation. So the reading is the expected one whether or not momentum is present. THE SIGNED SUM is unbiased and has the power: six independent seeds at y = 1e20 with 80000 samples give z of +0.65, +0.10, -1.13, +0.27, -0.87, -0.65, mean -0.27 and sd 0.71, t = -0.94 on 5 df. So no momentum is detected and M_theta,1/2 is SUPPORTED at these depths -- better supported than the positive-part reading could show. A trend of z = -0.07, +1.06, +1.98 across y = 1e12, 1e20, 1e30 was a single-seed artifact; all three shared the default seed and independent seeds centre at zero. SIZING: detecting a per-depth excess eps needs ESS_t >~ 1/(4 eps^2), and the census loses a factor about 72 from samples to ESS at depth 40. Nothing here moves the hypothesis; it corrects how the supporting measurement reads. Machinery: `tilted_share_power`, kept in pressure_direct rather than tao_reduction because the latter is a pinned Paper C input and a research addition should not force a paper rebuild.

Theorem A of the Tao-reduction note. If for some e > 1 − λ** = 0.5074… and all sufficiently large y, #{n odd in (y, 2y] : n does not reach 1} ≤ y (log y)^{−e}, then every positive integer reaches 1. Proof: every failure lies in the E-tree of an odd failure (forward closure), each E-tree level has log-mass ≤ 2/n₀ and at most 1 + log₂ log x levels meet [1, x], so the log-count of the failure set is ≪ (log x)^{1−e} log log x, contradicting fate contagion (J-fate-log-density) for any λ ∈ (1 − e, λ**). The E-tree bound, the dyadic sum and the contradiction given a contagion lower bound K (log x)^λ are Lean (tao_rate_implies_conjecture in FateTaoReduction.lean); the contagion bound itself (Theorem 5.3) stays a human proof, so this row is not Lean-verified. The same holds for the hypothesis stated over all n in (y, 2y], and in logarithmic form it is Corollary 4.5 of the fate note. A Tao-type almost-all theorem with the bounded target [1, N₀] and rate (log y)^{−0.53} would therefore prove the Juggler conjecture; for the Collatz map the analogous implication fails (thin preimage trees). Not a halt theorem: the hypothesis is not proved. The contagion hypothesis is discharged unconditionally at e > 103/203 = 0.50739 by Production.conjecture_of_tao_rate_averaged (J-oe-averaged-two-productions-reach-the-depth-two-ceiling), which is below Paper C's conditional 0.51. MEASURED (tao_reduction.unconditional_depth_drop): that moves the least unconditional cylinder depth from C = 23 to C = 19, and the pressure-form thresholds from 23, 50, 273, 1953 to 19, 41, 214, 1496 at q = 0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 0.62. Against lambda** itself nothing numerical moves -- those are the same 19, 41, 214, 1496 -- so what this buys is status, not constants.
